name: SnapEngage
description_en:
SnapEngage is a product in the Live chat category. Its directory profile covers Visitor Targeting, Transfers, Shortcut Messages, Persistent Chat, Offline Form, Knowledge Database, Co-Browsing, Call Me Option.

Additional listed capabilities include Agent Scheduling. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $16.00. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

资料还列出客服排班。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。
